content: Isra7eele Kawa Iyo7akaaza
Akaziyaasa na7ay, Yihuda Kawoy Iyo7aasi kawotida laatamanne heedzantho laythan, Iyyu na7ay Iyo7akaazi Isra7eele bolla kawotis; I Samaaren uttidi tammanne laapun laythi kawotis.
I, Isra7eele asaa balethida Iyorbaama soo asaa nagara kaallidi, Godaa sinthan iitaba oothis; I he nagaraa ooso aggibeenna.
Hessa gisho, Godaa hanqoy Isra7eele bolla suullis; Goday enta daro wode Araame kawa Azaheela, hessadaka iya na7aa Wolde-Adara kushen aathidi immis.
Hessafe guye, Iyo7akaazi Godaa woossis. Goday iya woosa si7is; Soore kawoy Isra7eele ay mela iita meton un7ethidaako Goday be7is.
Isra7eele asa ashshiya asi immin, enta Araame kushepe kessi ekidosona. Isra7eele asay kaseysada banta son saron de7idosona.
Hessi haninka Isra7eele asaa balethida Iyorbaama soo asaa nagaraape simmibokona; enti he nagaraa ooso aggibokona. Qassi Asheera geetetiya xoosse eeqa misiley Samaaren eqidi de7ees.
Iyo7akaazas ishatamu para asata, tammu gaareta, 10,000 toho olanchota, hara olanchota xalaali attidosona. Araame kawoy enta dhaysis; I enta wudumman de7iya suullada oothis.
Iyo7akaazi hanida harabay, I oothidaba ubbaynne iya minotethay Isra7eele Kawota Taarike Maxaafan xaafetis.
Iyo7akaazi hayqidi, ba mayzata gakis; iya bessan iya na7ay Yo7aasi kawotis.
Isra7eele Kawa Yo7aasa
Yihuda kawoy Iyo7aasi kawotida hastamanne laapuntho laythan, Iyo7akaaza na7ay Yo7aasi Samaaren Isra7eele bolla kawotis; I tammanne usupun laythi kawotis.
Yo7aasi Godaa sinthan iitabaa oothis. Isra7eele asaa balethida Nabaaxa na7aa Iyorbaama nagaraape issuwaka ashshona oothis; I he nagara ooso aggibeenna.
Yo7aasi hanida harabay, I oothidaba ubbaynne Yihuda Kawa Amasiyasara oletida olay Isra7eele Kawota Taarike Maxaafan xaafetis.
Yo7aasi hayqidi, ba mayzata gakis; Samaaren Isra7eele kawotara moogetis. Iya bessan iya na7ay Iyorbaami kawotis.
Elsa Hayquwa
Elsi hayqos gathiya harge hargetis; Isra7eele kawoy Yo7aasi iya be7anaw bidi, “Ta aawaw; ta aawaw, neeni Isra7eele asaas wolqanne gondalle!” yaagidi yeekis.
Elsi, “Dongenne donge toora ekada ya” yaagin, Yo7aasi ehis.
Elsi kawako, “Dongiya giigisa oyka” yaagis; I dongiya giigisidi oykidashin, Elsi ba kushiya kawa kushiya bolla wothis.

Elsi, “Doloha bagga maskootiya dooya” yaagis. I dooyin, Elsi, “Donge tooran duka” yaagis. I dukin Elsi, “Haysi Godaa donge! Haysi Araame asaa xooniya donge! Neeni Araame asaa Afeeqan xoonana gakanaw olana” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, Elsi kawako, “Donge toorata eka” yaagis. I ekin, Elsi, “Biittaa cadda” yaagis. I heedzu toho biitta caddidi aggaagis.
Xoossa addey, kawa bolla hanqetidi, “Ichashu toho woyko usupun toho biitta caddidaba gidiyako, neeni Araame asaa xoonada kumethi dhaysanashin! Neeni ha77i enta heedzu toho xalaala xoonana” yaagis.
Elsi hayqidi moogetis. Moo7abe paannoti Isra7eele biitta bolla laythan laythan dendoosona.
Issi gallas guutha Isra7eele asati issi uraa aha moogishe, Heko, Moo7abe paannota be7idosona. Uraa aha Elsa duufuwa giddo holidi baqatidosona. Ahay Elsa meqethaa bolla wodhidi, paxidi dendi eqis.
Iyo7akaazi kawotida laytha ubban Soore Kawoy Azaheeli Isra7eele un7ethis.
Shin Goday Abrahaamera, Yisaaqaranne Yayqoobara caaqida caaquwa gisho, entaw keehis, qadhetis, qopis. Hachi gakanaw I enta dhaysibeenna woyko ba sinthafe diggibeenna.
Araame kawoy Azaheeli hayqin, iya bessan iya na7ay Wolde-Adari kawotis.
Azaheeli iya aawa Iyo7akaazi olan oykida katamata, Iyo7akaaza na7ay Yo7aasi Azaheela na7aa Wolde-Adarape ekis. Yo7aasi iya heedzu toho xoonidi, Isra7eele katamata zaaris.
